dedupe_keys.name: ecolopes voxel model data for ecological building envelope design vienna case study

description: This dataset holds the ECOLOPES Voxel Model for a Vienna case study, a spatial data structure that stores and correlates multi-domain data for the ontology-aided generative design of ecological building envelopes serving humans, plants, animals and microbiota. It was deposited on Zenodo on 8 November 2024 by Jakub Tyc and Albin Ahmeti of TU Wien with Defne Sunguroglu Hensel and Michael Hensel, from the Horizon 2020 Future and Emerging Technologies project 'ECOlogical building enveLOPES'. The voxel model is the component of the computational workflow in which initial envelope designs are generated and analysed; the voxel data layers are listed and described in Appendix A of the published paper, and the data were exported from a PostgreSQL database to CSV. Coverage: one Vienna case study site. Access: one 315 MB CSV on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: layer definitions are in the paper appendix, not the deposit. Simulation uses: design of green facades and multi-species building envelopes, linking microclimate, vegetation and habitat data. Related records: the London CAZ green roofs dataset and the Vienna water features case study.
